subject: social
title: Maps and Globes
about: Maps and globes, the map key and symbols, the compass rose and the four cardinal directions, continents and oceans. NC 1.G.1.2 (symbols on maps) and 1.G.1.1 (maps and globes).
tip: Hold a map with north at the top and have him point north, south, east and west with his arm.

cards.q: What is a round model of the Earth called?
cards.note: A globe is round like the Earth. You can spin it.

cards.q: What is a flat drawing of a place seen from above called?
cards.note: A map shows a place the way a bird sees it from the sky.

cards.q: What is the box that explains what the symbols on a map mean?
cards.note: A map key is also called a legend.

cards.q: What do we call the small pictures on a map that stand for real things?
cards.note: A tiny school picture on a map means a real school is there.

cards.q: What on a map shows north, south, east and west?
cards.note: The compass rose has arrows for the four directions.

cards.q: Which direction is usually at the top of a map?
cards.note: Most maps put north at the top.

cards.q: Which direction is usually at the bottom of a map?
cards.note: When north is at the top, south is at the bottom.

cards.q: What is the opposite of east?
cards.note: East and west are opposites. On most maps, east is on the right and west is on the left.

cards.q: What is the opposite of north?
Which way does the sun come up in the morning?
cards.note: The sun rises in the east.

cards.q: Which way does the sun go down in the evening?
cards.note: The sun sets in the west.

cards.q: What does blue on a map usually show?
cards.note: Blue on a map shows water. Green often shows land with plants.

cards.q: What would a map of your classroom, seen from above, show?
cards.note: A classroom map shows the room from above, like looking down from the ceiling.

cards.q: What tells you what a map is about?
cards.note: The title is the name at the top of the map.

cards.q: What are the very big pieces of land on a globe called?
cards.note: Continents are the biggest pieces of land on Earth.

cards.q: How many continents are on Earth?
What are the huge salty waters that cover most of the Earth called?
cards.note: Oceans are salty and cover most of the Earth.
